description: This PHP source file defines the Header class in the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the reporting module. It manages report headers, including managing columns (of types Column or StackedColumn) and associated metadata, providing methods for adding columns, normalization, and metadata handling.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Represents a report header containing columns and optional metadata, with functionality to add columns, normalize header data, and manage metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Header object with an array of columns.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns the array of columns in the header.

methods.name: setColumns
methods.description: Sets the array of columns for the header, adding each via addColumn.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a single column to the header, with type validation for Column or StackedColumn.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns the header data as an array, converting each column to array form.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Retrieves the optional metadata associated with the header.

methods.name: setMeta
methods.description: Sets the optional metadata for the header.
